candidate.educational_objective: Explain the safety purpose of Tall Man lettering.

options.A: To distinguish look-alike drug names and reduce name-selection errors.
options.B: To identify both medications as controlled substances.
options.C: To show that the medications require refrigeration.
options.D: To indicate that the medications have expired.

candidate.rationale: FDA Tall Man lettering selectively capitalizes portions of look-alike drug names to make their differences more visually apparent. FDA specifically lists hydrALAZINE and hydrOXYzine as a pair for name differentiation.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Tall Man lettering emphasizes distinguishing letters in look-alike medication names to reduce confusion.
candidate.source_locator: Tall Man lettering / FDA List of Established Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters—hydrALAZINE and hydrOXYzine
candidate.stem: A medication label uses the names hydrALAZINE and hydrOXYzine. What is the purpose of the capitalized letters?
